figure_candidates.label: Scheme 1
figure_candidates.caption: Scheme 1. Compounds purified from C. arbuscula. Compounds 1 and 2 were purified from the wild type and 3–12 from the DhdaA mutant.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. HPLC contour plot of extracts from the wild-type and DhdaA
C. arbuscula strains. The boxed region contains compounds 3–12,
which were isolated in this work.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Characterization of arbumycin (3) and its gene cluster in
C. arbuscula. a) The putative gene cluster for the biosynthesis of 3.
b) Genetic verification of the gene cluster responsible for the biosyn-
thesis of 3. c) Proposed pathway for the biosynthesis of 3.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Overproduction of compounds in the DhdaA mutant.
a) Compounds 3–9, 11, and 12 are formed in higher yields in the
DhdaA mutant based on EIC than compound 1. b) RT-PCR analysis of
the gene expression of selected core genes. The housekeeping actA
gene served as the internal control. The contig numbers (with
corresponding compounds in parentheses) are also shown.

figure_candidates.label: Scheme 2
figure_candidates.caption: Scheme 2. Proposed pathways for the biosynthesis of 9–12.
